name: Book of Blinding Light
description:
Fast Action: Equip this to your Albedo.
Summon Solar Isotoma.
When you summon Solar Isotoma, create 2 stacks of Silver Isotoma, and generate 1 random basic Elemental Die.
(You must have Albedo in your deck to add this card to your deck.)

storytext: "Alice asked me to set you a task in the form of a story annotation, but I'm no storyteller, and I can't remember what that strange tale was about. Your performance has already far exceeded my expectations, and unlike Barbeloth, I have no odd hobby of teasing my apprentices. So, keep up the good work. I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of 'homework' you'll bring me next time we meet."
